ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface; high-intensity white pixels constitute less than 3% of the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark pigmentation across the primary surface. Discrete high-contrast white focal points are localized near the terminal tips and in a sparse cluster on the mid-lateral right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate 35-degree interior angle and a vertical pixel depth of roughly 12% of the lobe's vertical extent.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary with frequent high-amplitude serrations (peaks of 5-15 pixels) and multiple secondary notches along both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep trajectory originating from the central notch and extending to tapered terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (likely barnacle attachment sites) located at the far left tip and scattered across the dorsal-medial section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct irregular notch/indentation on the distal portion of the left lobe; numerous small depigmented spots on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-intensity occlusion from water turbulence and spray covering the inferior-medial margins of the fluke.
